compute_weighted_mse_per_level: compute a latitude and pressure level weighted MSE loss between predictions and targets
sum_per_variable_losses: compute a weighted sum of per variable losses from a mapping of variable names to loss arrays
compute_normalized_level_weights: compute pressure proportional normalized level weights from an xarray DataArray with level coordinates

review_LossFunction_protocol: review the LossFunction protocol interface for predictions and targets xarray Dataset arguments
